SYNTHETIC OFFLINE COMPLETE TRADING PLAN p1
Symbol: 601021.SH; market: SSE. This is invented test data, not a market recommendation or user plan.
Authored 2026-08-19 18:00:00 Asia/Shanghai; available 2026-08-19 18:01:00 Asia/Shanghai. Effective trading date: 2026-08-20. This is a complete replacement of all earlier ordinary rules.
Opening cash is exactly CNY 10,000.00 (1,000,000 fen), with zero CORE shares, zero TACTICAL shares and no opening lots. The opening account snapshot is 2026-08-20 09:00:00 Asia/Shanghai.
Maximum total position: 300 shares. No CORE or TACTICAL target allocation is inferred. Holdings and cash carry forward from the first opening account; only simulated fills change them.
Ordinary rule ordinary-chain: Buy exactly 100 TACTICAL shares once when a completed five-minute close is strictly below 1,100 fen per share. The rule is valid while this version is active. Confirm using a completed five-minute bar, execute within the current session, and allow one planned quantity per independent occurrence. A new occurrence requires an explicit reviewed independent event linked to the prior signal; continuing true evidence and calendar changes do not reset consumption. Risk or reviewed invalidation ends ordinary authority; conflicting ordinary buy/sell instructions block both.
No new risk branch or pure alert is defined. Existing risk obligations survive replacement; their explicit shared reassessment requirements continue. Severe risk precedes ordinary risk.
Simulation assumptions: FOLLOW_REMINDERS, zero-second response delay, full quantity at the next eligible completed one-minute close, one-fen tick, next-exchange-session settlement (T+1), CORE protection, block unverified special states. Commission rate zero with minimum commission 500 fen each side; stamp duty zero, transfer fee zero, buy/sell slippage zero. These are synthetic test assumptions. No recorded future transactions, partial fills, external fundamentals or discretionary conditions.
